lines.text: choose the hero on purpose, not an attractor: a glowing circle or orb, a dusk sun or crescent, a light-poetry name like Vesper
pick one thread that carries through (an object, a type line, a colour or a rhythm), not separate reveals one after another
draw three directions from different materials (type, paper, liquid, cut geometry, photograph, UI, light), not three colours of one idea; at most one is light
keep the accent on one thing, not a full-frame flood
show the subject by 0.1 s, not an empty ground for the first half second
put soft colour blobs behind the content, not one flat fill
give each frame one focal point and one accent colour, not two things fighting
set a read line at a 6% cap height and hold it max(1.2 s, words/3), not a small tagline that flashes by
use the kit's face and ground or a face the direction chose, not Inter or Space Grotesk by habit
leave beats with no words, not text in every frame
take a line off screen when it is read plus 1.5 s, not hold it for the beat
turn the world every 1 to 2 s (a new element, a cut, a ground swap), not one lockup held
cut, wipe on the motion or match a shape, not a muddy crossfade
change axis or direction at every moving seam, not the same seam move twice
make each entrance a move with an origin, not everything fading in
exit shorter than the entrance on EASE.launch, not an exit as long as its entrance
keep one part moving in every hold (typing, a counter, a glint), not a frozen frame and not a camera drift
take curves from EASE names (or a sampled spring), not a CSS keyword or a hand-fitted cubic-bezier
land about 1 in 3 arrivals with a spring (EASE.pop), not every arrival on one soft stop
put each move in a speed band with the slowest move 3x the fastest, not every move at one duration
keep the fastest moves under 12 frame heights a second, not every move at full speed
stagger a group 30 to 80 ms, not a group that lands on one frame
keep gradients clean with 1 to 2% grain, not banding rings or a straight seam in a glow
let every mark ride its parent, not a mark that points at nothing
end on motion in the last 1 s, not a frozen lockup
pad each reveal mask 0.3 em past the glyphs, not letters cut by their own reveal
use a stock device (sheen band, lens streak, light beam, accent bar, rule line) once, not as the idea
tie each cue to one visible event and cue the first and the last key word, not a tick on every word
keep the true peak at or below -3 dBFS and the mix near -20 LUFS, not a mix pushed loud
